notes: Test NPC proving the system is generic: a fictional young lookout with a few lines, Talk and Leave only.

text: Quiet on the path. Too quiet, Ģirts would say.
You're new. I'm Arvīds. I watch the path, mostly I watch squirrels.

goodbyes: I'll whistle if anyone comes. Twice for soldiers.

topics.title: What do you think of Ģirts?

a_path.text: A fox, an hour ago. Unless the fox was wearing boots.

a_watch.text: Cold. Long. I count trees. There are four hundred and twelve, or I fell asleep somewhere around two hundred.

a_girts.text: He frightens me a little. He knows things he doesn't say. But he gave me his own scarf last winter.

a_girts_knows.text: Ask him yourself. He likes you better than me. He likes the goat better than me.

a_home.text: A farm north of here. There's nobody there now. Let's not talk about it.
